privacy: Viewer and CPU are roles. Names, user IDs, credentials, session URLs and request bodies are omitted. Native role IDs and physical tokens are synthetic test values, not captured server IDs.
model_provenance: Displayed names and facts are mapped to official-v2/cards.json:4 sell,26 naginata-classic (neutral ATK7,price3),46 spiritual-staff (neutral ATK12,cutCost,price20),69 sword-ware (Stone ATK2,price2). The model46 received after the sale was identified by its tooltip on the later viewer turn. The later ATK13 gift is not identified.
hand_count_policy: viewer_visible_hand_count counts displayed physical copies. The initial nine displayed copies consist of three trade cards,three weapons and three armors;two trade copies are model4 and one weapon is model26. Other initial models are not fully transcribed. No initial used miracle copy was displayed. The CPU hand and its count remain unknown. Counts exclude the composed action cards and duplicate hover-detail displays.
observed_guardians_and_curses: No guardian or curse indicator was shown for either role at the recorded checkpoints.
